ProgramUnit.Name: VALIDATE_EFF_TERM_DATES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE validate_eff_term_dates ( eff_date in date
 ,term_date in date
 ,from_where in varchar2 
 ) 
IS
 dt_chk boolean;
 
BEGIN
 IF eff_date IS NULL 
 THEN
 show_error('5002');
 END IF;
 IF eff_date < TRUNC(get_local_date) 
 AND from_where = 'E' 
 THEN
 show_error('5015');
 END IF;

 IF term_date IS NOT NULL 
 THEN
 IF term_date < TRUNC(get_local_date) 
 THEN
 show_error('3115');
 END IF;
 
 dt_chk := check_from_to_date(eff_date,term_date);

 IF dt_chk 
 THEN
 null;
 ELSE
 --message('Err. Term date is before effective date.');
 --raise form_trigger_failure;
 show_error('5004');
 END IF;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_LOCAL_DATE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION get_local_date(v_date IN DATE DEFAULT SYSDATE) RETURN DATE
 /* Function to return local date value, in case no parameter this
 will return system date converted to local date--*/
 /* -- IM 215 
 Function returns local date time of the selected chapter.
 */
IS
 v_localdate DATE;
BEGIN
 /* To display local time*/
 IF is_timezone_enabled 
 THEN
 --Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:GLOBAL.chapter_id,v_date ,v_localdate); -- IM 215
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:ctrl_block.chapter_id,v_date ,v_localdate); -- IM 215
 ELSE
 v_localdate := SYSDATE;
 END IF;

 RETURN v_localdate;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: VALIDATE_RECORDS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Validate_records IS
BEGIN
 GO_BLOCK('VALID_CHAPTER_DST_OFFSET');
 first_record;
 loop
 IF TO_Char(:VALID_CHAPTER_DST_OFFSET.start_time,'YYYY') = To_Char(:CTRL_VCDO.start_time,'YYYY')
 THEN
 show_error('11156');
 Raise form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;
 
 IF TO_Char(:VALID_CHAPTER_DST_OFFSET.end_time,'YYYY') = To_Char(:CTRL_VCDO.end_time,'YYYY')
 THEN
 show_error('11156');
 Raise form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;
 
 IF :System.Last_Record = 'TRUE' 
 THEN 
 exit; 
 ELSE next_record; 
 END IF; 
 
 end loop;
 GO_BLOCK('CTRL_VCDO');
END;

RecordGroup.Name: RG_TIME_ZONE
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select distinct substr(tz_offset(tzname),1,6) v_offset,tzname from v$timezone_names where substr(tz_offset(tzname),1,6) = :ctrl_vcdo.tz_base_diff and substr(tz_offset(tzname),1,6) in (select description from valid_master_codes where upper(code_type) = 'TZONE' and :parameter.p_local_time between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1))order by to_number(substr(tz_offset(tzname),1,1)||1*substr(tz_offset(tzname),2,2)||substr(tz_offset(tzname),5,2)),2

Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 procedure format_error is
 temp_format varchar2(100);
 temp_pos number;
 begin
 temp_format := upper(GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:system.cursor_item,FORMAT_MASK));
 -- remove FM or FX format prefix
 if substr(temp_format,1,2) in ('FX','FM') then
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,3);
 end if;
 -- remove double quotes and change 0 to 9
 temp_format := translate(temp_format,'0"','9');
 -- change HH24 to HH
 temp_pos := instr(temp_format,'HH24');
 if temp_pos != 0 then
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,1,temp_pos-1)||'HH'||
 substr(temp_format,temp_pos + 4);
 end if;
 -- change multiple RR to YY
 loop
 temp_pos := instr(temp_format,'RR');
 exit when temp_pos = 0;
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,1,temp_pos-1)||'YY'||
 substr(temp_format,temp_pos + 2);
 end loop;
 show_error('0022',temp_format );
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 
begin
 if error_code = 40100 -- at first record
 then
 show_error('1700');
 elsif error_code = 40102 -- record must be entered first
 then
 show_error('1701');
 elsif error_code = 40200 -- field protected against update
 then
 show_error('1702');
 elsif error_code = 41830 --list values contains no entries
 then
 show_error('12019');
 elsif error_code = 40201 -- field is full
 then
 show_error('1703');
 elsif error_code = 40202 -- field must be entered
 then
 show_error('0080');
 elsif error_code = 40207 -- must be in range
 then
 show_error('1704');
 elsif error_code = 40208 -- form in query mode, cant update
 then
 show_error('1705');
 elsif error_code = 41800 --list not available
 then
 show_error('1180');
 elsif error_code = 41008 --list not available
 then
 show_error('1180');
 ---------- Following added by Mukesh 05/28 --------------
 elsif error_code = 41009 --Function key not allowed
 then
 show_error('1180');
 elsif error_code = 41051 --Can not create records here
 then
 show_error('12038');
 ----------------------------------------------------------
 elsif error_code = 40200 -- field protected against update
 then
 show_error('5050');
 elsif error_code in (40400,40406,40407)-- transaction committed
 then
 show_error('8010');
 elsif error_code = 40401 -- no changes to commit
 then
 show_error('8013');
 elsif error_code in (50002,50003,50004, -- invalid date
 50011,50012,50021,50023,50026)
 then
 format_error;
 elsif error_code in (50006,50007,50009, -- invalid number
 50013,50014,50015,50016,50020)
 then
 format_error;
 elsif error_code in (50017,50018,50019,50022) -- invalid time
 then
 format_error;
 elsif error_code in ('0','40209') -- invalid format
 then
 format_error;
 else
 message(substr(error_type||'-'||to_char (error_code)
 ||': '||error_text,1,80));
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 check_package_failure;
end;
